# Constraints for CI's pip installs (`pip install -c .github/ci-constraints.txt`).
# pyproject.toml keeps its ranges; these pins make CI test what the campaign runs.
#
# transformers: the campaign venvs run 5.16.1, and the GLM source derivative
# (prismaquant/glm_source_derivative.py) binds the modeling_glm5_next.py that
# 5.16.1 ships. transformers 5.17.0 ships another file, so tests of the
# derivative cannot run on it (#1419).
transformers==5.16.1
